decisive_items: herniation into the greater sciatic foramen
Revealed herniation into the greater sciatic foramen with proximal ureteral dilatation
response.rationale: Imaging directly demonstrates herniation into the greater sciatic foramen with proximal ureteral dilatation, making sciatic hernia the specific underlying diagnosis; ureteral obstruction is the downstream consequence, and fever/chills are nonspecific.

rejected.why: Describes the obstructive effect rather than the underlying cause identified on imaging.
Fever and chills are nons and not supported by imaging findings of pyelonephritis; they likely reflect complications of obstruction.
